“Nobody wants to work anymore”…
or maybe the hiring process is just completely broken.

In this video, we go through what people are actually dealing with right now — hundreds of applications, constant ghosting, weird interview questions, and jobs that don’t make any sense.

From bait questions and impossible requirements…
to canceled interviews, 6-day work weeks, and “remote on Sunday” jobs.

At a certain point it’s not about people not wanting to work —
it’s about how ridiculous the process has become.
